title: Integer coordinates of quotient generator germs
statement: Let X be a topological space and iota:K -> C a monomorphism of abelian sheaves, with C isomorphic to the constant integer sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Let A_j, j in Fin n, be open sets, labels 0<c_j<=b+1, and g:coproduct_j j_{A_j!}Z -> K an epimorphism [def-sc-abelian-open-extension-by-zero]. Suppose component j sends its canonical unit section to s_j and iota(s_j) has constant integer value c_j. Let l:L -> K be any monomorphism. Fix x with zero L stalk [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] outside V=union_{c_j<=b} A_j, and an index i with x in A_i. Every element of the cokernel(l) stalk at x is a unique integer multiple of the germ of cokernel.π(l)(s_i).

proof.text: For each active index k, exclusion from the lower-label union gives not c k <= b. Together with hc k this implies c k = b+1.

Reuse constantSubsheaf_canonical_stalks, the proved private helper of ConstantSubsheafStalkBound, via a proof-only import all. Its germ/unit formula and hvalue identify the image under the stalk of iota followed by isoC with b+1. Preservation of monomorphisms makes this map injective, so every active section germ equals the chosen germ v.

Construct q:ULift Z -> K_x as z maps to z.down smul v. Show q is epi by proving its cokernel projection is zero: precompose with the stalk of g and use the preserved coproduct universal property. On an active component every element is an integer multiple of the unit germ by abelianOpenExtension_integer_germ_coordinates; germ naturality and hsection send it to the same multiple of v, killed by cokernel.condition. An inactive component has zero stalk by abelianOpenExtensionByZero_stalks. Cancel the epimorphism stalk(g), then apply Abelian.epi_of_cokernel_π_eq_zero. Injectivity of q follows by mapping to the canonical integers and cancelling the nonzero multiplier b+1.

The stalk functor preserves the cokernel cofork. Since L_x is zero, stalk(l)=0. CokernelCofork.IsColimit.isIso_π applied to the mapped cofork proves that p=stalk(cokernel.π l) is an isomorphism. Its germ naturality identifies p(v) with the displayed quotient generator. Surjectivity of p and q gives the integer coordinate; injectivity of both gives uniqueness.

proof_origin.place: Stacks Lemma 0A38, final filtration paragraph. Lean proof by Y3 using the proved canonical constant-stalk helper, extension-by-zero integer coordinates, the preserved coproduct universal property, and Mathlib preservation of cokernel coforks.

theorem constantSubsheaf_quotient_germ_coordinates
    (X : TopCat.{u}) (K C : Sheaf AddCommGrpCat X) (ι : K ⟶ C) [Mono ι]
    (isoC : C ≅ (constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
      (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))
    (n : ℕ) (A : Fin n → Opens X) (c : Fin n → ℕ)
    (g : (∐ fun i => (abelianOpenExtensionByZero (A i)).obj
      ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (A i)))
        AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))) ⟶ K) [Epi g]
    (s : ∀ i, K.obj.obj (op (A i)))
    (hsection : ∀ i,
      (Sigma.ι (fun j => (abelianOpenExtensionByZero (A j)).obj
        ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (A j)))
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))) i ≫ g).hom.app
        (op (A i))
        (abelianOpenExtensionSection (A i)
          ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (A i)))
            AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))) (A i) le_rfl
          ((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (A i)))
            ((Functor.const (Opens ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (A i)))ᵒᵖ).obj
              (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))).app
            (op ((Opens.map (A i).inclusion').obj (A i))) (ULift.up 1))) = s i)
    (hvalue : ∀ i, (ι ≫ isoC.hom).hom.app (op (A i)) (s i) =
      (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        ((Functor.const (Opens X)ᵒᵖ).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))).app
          (op (A i)) (ULift.up (c i : ℤ)))
    (b : ℕ) (hc : ∀ i, 0 < c i ∧ c i ≤ b + 1)
    (L : Sheaf AddCommGrpCat X) (l : L ⟶ K) [Mono l]
    (x : X) (hxL : IsZero (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk L.obj x))
    (hxV : x ∉ ⨆ j : Fin n, if c j ≤ b then A j else ⊥)
    (i : Fin n) (hxi : x ∈ A i) :
    ∀ t : ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := AddCommGrpCat.{u}) (cokernel l).obj x),
      ∃! z : ℤ, z • (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (cokernel l).obj (A i) x hxi
        ((cokernel.π l).hom.app (op (A i)) (s i))) = t
